title: M8a progression and skill class core - isolated packet
purpose: Implement the unique XP, skill and class business logic consumed by later camp menus, without owning their UI.
task: Implement §8.9 XP kill attribution and level rollover, all skill-buy/class-select transactions, class kit-on-deploy and explicit named method hooks; preserve pre-existing point/HQ/win XP credits.

in: Determine XP on hostile SM_Marine death by tier, unknown hostile marine=Regular; full player kills and half FL_SoldierUS kills; resolve killer via e.Inflictor, if projectile then its target, per spec; reward MVP_ArmyTruck=60, MVP_APC=120, MVP_MBT=250 without duplicates.

Use existing GiveXP for capture +50, German target +150, win +500 already in Handler.zs; extend/refactor only as needed for complete while rollover of FL_XP across 300*currentLevel, one skill point per level, and battleXP accounting. Preserve loss/down semantics, max level 99.

Implement M8A_BuySkill(skillIndex) for the exact 10 skill item classes in existing Items.zs order; transaction costs exactly 1 point/rank and rejects missing points/max rank 3; existing FL_Stats computes skill effects and must not be rewritten.

Implement M8A_SelectClass(classId) for Rifleman=1, Assault=2, Engineer=3, Officer=4 and free selection. Check/refine existing GiveKit/DeployToBattle transaction only if necessary: no long gun -> Garand/Thompson as specified, +64 Clip; Engineer +2 satchels.

Provide XP/skills/class executable acceptance scenarios to be integrated by operator and Call 4 T13b owner; log and stop on uncertain ZScript WorldEvent/e.Inflictor/damage attribution semantics rather than inventing successful tests.
out: Roster UI, station menu text/dispatch, T13b ownership, loot chance/drops, building, shipping and any donor/director retuning.

constraints: Use only the specifically supplied source files. source_001_FRONTLINE44_SPEC.md controls, including the approved §8.6 debut reservation. Distinguish verified source facts from untested engine hypotheses.

Parallel source authoring only; the operator alone integrates in M7→M8→M9→M10 order, repairs compiler/API faults, runs the engine, accepts milestones and ships. No engine is assumed available to this call; never claim that load or any test PASS was executed.

ZScript only for gameplay; all custom files under frontline/; no donor code modifications; FL_ custom class prefix and fl_ CVar prefix; every newly introduced production number other than 0/1 must be declared in FL_T. Do not weaken tests or change existing PASS semantics.

Preserve M0–M6 baselines and T1–T11/T13 arg0/T16; no whole-file Handler.zs, Tests.zs, Tuning.zs, zscript.zs, mapinfo.txt or keyconf.txt rewrites. A parallel implementation must provide method-only fragments and a machine-readable hooks.json for operator application.

Frozen-source status conflict: source_002 claims M6/T10 PASS while source_012 records T10 FAIL and source_016 was an unrun proposal. Treat current M6 verification as an operator preflight gate, not a proved PASS; never change director economics within this job.

Result is inert code; report unverified ZScript signature assumptions as PARTIAL/BLOCKED and provide diagnostics. Do not silently add game features, implement test-only cheats, relax thresholds or edit donor code.

Do not modify World.zs (Call 1), Items.zs (Call 3), or any baseline gameplay file directly; include M8A_ Handler methods and tightly scoped proposed GiveXP/GiveKit body replacement in fragments with exact match anchors.
Operator owns the single Handler.WorldThingDied override; M8A_OnDeath(WorldEvent e) is dispatched first, M8L_OnDeath(e) second. Do not create competing death overrides.

Caller integration contract: bool M8A_BuySkill(int skillIndex) using indices 0..9 in spec list order; bool M8A_SelectClass(int classId) 1..4. Call 4 presents those choices but calls these exact routines and does not recreate purchase mechanics. Any API deviation must be explicit BLOCKED.
Do not credit XP for existing point, HQ or win events a second time; no XP for friendly deaths, null killer, non-awarded entities, repeat callbacks, or test-spawn setup alone.
Production logic changes must pass original T7/T13 arg0/T16; joint T13 arg1 test belongs to Call 4 and remains unexecuted here.
